reason: I run the floor, I don't sign up for things - the owner does, and ₹1,500 is small but it is still his money and his decision. And honestly it solves the fight over a frame, not the empty Tuesday; it assumes I already have a league night running, and I don't.
objection: Does this actually get more people through the door, or am I just doing more admin on the same twelve regulars? Nobody has shown me how to even start a league night, and the software starts at the bracket, which is step three.
would_change_my_mind: Show me two or three venues like mine in India with real before-and-after footfall on their competition night, plus a simple week-by-week guide to starting one from nothing - then I take it to the owner myself and run the free month.
